questions.question: How long does standard shipping take?

questions.question: What does express shipping cost and how fast is it?
questions.reference_answer: Express shipping costs $12.99 and delivers within 2 business days of dispatch.

questions.question: Do you ship internationally?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. We ship to 32 countries. International delivery takes 10 to 14 business days, and the customer pays any customs duties and import taxes.

questions.question: What is the cut-off time for same-day dispatch?
questions.reference_answer: Orders placed before 2:00 PM Eastern Time on a business day are dispatched the same day.

questions.question: What is your return window?
questions.reference_answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery.

questions.question: How long do refunds take?
questions.reference_answer: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days after we receive the returned item.

questions.question: How long is the warranty?
questions.reference_answer: Tents and backpacks have a 2 year warranty. Cooking stoves and headlamps have a 1 year warranty. Sleeping bags have a 5 year warranty.

questions.question: Is the warranty transferable?
questions.reference_answer: No. The warranty applies to the original purchaser only and requires proof of purchase.

questions.question: Which payment methods do you accept?

questions.question: How do I reset my password?
questions.reference_answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the login page. The reset link we email expires after 30 minutes.

questions.question: Do you offer discounts for bulk or group orders?

questions.question: How do Trail Points work, and how long are gift cards valid?
